p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: In Wwox-deficient neocortical slices or human neurons at matched maturity: spontaneous burst frequency, duration, amplitude and phase-amplitude coupling under a graded memantine exposure versus a perampanel exposure versus the full NMDAR block, with the wild-type and heterozygous slices as internal comparators; then a developmental endpoint (myelin, synaptic maturation), because burst control alone is not recovery.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: d-APV abolishes bursting in the knockout slice (5 slices, 3 animals); the mEPSC amplitude (probably AMPAR-weighted, an inference) is raised; a delayed evoked response is NMDAR-dependent. No memantine or perampanel has been given to any Wwox system. Seven antiseizure drugs including perampanel gave no sustained benefit in one adult human case.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Juvenile mouse slices, one laboratory, acute pharmacology; the authors themselves bound the age window; human organoid and clinical rows do not test the node.

cellular_context.target_expression: GRIN1, GRIN2B and GRIN2D transcripts are present in the week-15 organoid (counts per million in the W2 table); GRIA1 is present; higher in two of four knockouts, overlapping wild type in the other two.
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: layer II/III neocortical pyramidal neurons for the slice rows; bulk organoid for transcripts.
cellular_context.limits: No receptor-level measurement of NMDAR or AMPAR current, subunit composition or surface level exists for any WWOX system.

mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Partial benefit / protection of function at best (network state); WWOX function stays lost. Variant-independent (Track A); Track B (missense class) unmeasured. Seizure or burst control is not developmental recovery (N-15).
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_card.identity: Memantine (approved, uncompetitive NMDAR pore blocker; paediatric safety and effectiveness not established on its label) and perampanel (approved, non-competitive AMPAR antagonist; paediatric label for partial-onset seizures). Tool compounds: d-APV. Both are symptomatic-network levers on one measured phenotype, not WWOX restoration.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Only IF the neuron-specific Wwox bursting phenotype is driven by a measurable gain in glutamatergic transmission that a partial block of NMDAR or AMPAR corrects without harming activity-dependent maturation. Transfer to the reference genotype is unmeasured for both alleles: the slice model is a Synapsin-Cre knockout, not a missense or splice allele.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Memantine on the NMDAR node is already map record R-02 (class PROMISING_BUT_MECHANISTIC_GAP). New here: (1) the sign of the receptor lesion decides memantine's response in the one genetic-NMDAR cohort that stratified by function, so the 'GRIN2A corroborates the node' argument (DL-MECH-002) corroborates the node, not the sign; (2) the AMPAR arm, never carried as a node, rests on the only direct synaptic measurement in the knockout (raised mEPSC amplitude), and is untested. Coverage: PubMed searches of 2026-10-27 (GRIN-memantine, neonatal memantine, WWOX myelin), the Karnstedt full text, the repository's perampanel notes; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA for any memantine or perampanel arm in a Wwox model, not MAI_TENTATO.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: map R-02 (memantine), Chain B, N-15 (seizure control is not development), DL-MECH-002, DL-MOL-001; perampanel appears only in cohort notes (repurposing_10h_scientist-d_20261022c.md, parked item) and the adult case.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A; Track B untested.
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. At best a reduction of a network state; no developmental benefit is implied.
p4_card.mechanism: Targets: NMDAR (GRIN1 with GRIN2A/2B/2D) and AMPAR (GRIA1-4). Direction wanted: lower excitatory gain. Context: juvenile neocortical slice, neuron-specific knockout. Memantine is a use-dependent pore blocker with subunit-dependent, assay-dependent potency; d-APV is a competitive full block: the tool result does not transfer quantitatively to the drug.

external_not_wwox_evidence: PubMed abstract of PMID 42190144 (gene names are stripped in the retrieved text; the GRIN2A variant class is not stated there)

for: d-APV abolishes bursting in the knockout slice and suppresses a knockout-specific delayed response.
Postsynaptic mEPSC amplitude is raised in the knockout.
Memantine benefited most individuals with gain-of-function GRIN variants (precedent in a channelopathy, other disease).
against: The only memantine-responsive genetic NMDAR group is defined by receptor gain of function; loss-of-function and indeterminate GRIN variants did not respond, so 'an NMDAR gene causes the same phenotype' (DL-MECH-002) does not give the sign.
Dependence of bursting on NMDAR activity is permissive: it does not show that NMDAR function is raised; no NMDAR current or subunit was measured.
A full competitive block (d-APV) eliminated bursting; a partial pore block at tolerable exposure may not; potency spans orders of magnitude across assays.
Memantine accelerated provoked seizures in an adult rat oxygen model; its paediatric effectiveness is not established on its label.
One adult WWOX case on perampanel plus six other drugs showed no sustained benefit (n = 1, not interpretable).
Suppressing a network state is not correcting a developmental lesion (N-15).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Juvenile slice, one laboratory, knockout not allele; chronic NMDAR or AMPAR blockade in a developing brain also acts on activity-dependent maturation, including myelination (see F02).

p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN for research use; both are marketed drugs (labels retrieved 2026-10-27).
p4_card.pharmacology: Memantine: use-dependent channel blocker; recorded potency depends on voltage, magnesium and agonist level and spans several orders of magnitude across assays (README section 4). Perampanel: non-competitive AMPAR antagonist. CNS exposure for both is expected from their indications but is not verified here for the slice-relevant free fraction.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: Memantine label: paediatric safety and effectiveness not established; two controlled paediatric autism studies failed. Perampanel label: partial-onset seizures from 4 years of age. Interactions and labelled warnings were NOT assessed (adapter sections lacked them). No paediatric suitability for WWOX-DEE is presumed.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: One laboratory for every WWOX row used here; no independent replication.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Breton rows carry verbatim locators in the manifest (receipt FTR-20260810-34634460-02); the n values of the d-APV arm and the mEPSC text were re-read first-hand from the shared full-text XML on 2026-10-27 without a new receipt. GRIN and rat rows are at the reading depth stated per row.
scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: Every statement marked INFERENZA, and every card-level synthesis, is owed a blind audit by someone other than the producer.

p4_card.predictions: Registered before any experiment: (a) if bursting reflects raised NMDAR function, a partial memantine exposure lowers burst frequency in knockout slices dose-dependently and not in wild type; (b) if it reflects raised AMPAR gain, perampanel does and memantine less; (c) if both are permissive routes of a network that recruits NMDAR, only the full block works and neither drug is a lever. Result (c) closes the strand.
p4_card.next_measurement: Wet-lab, not done: Wwox-deficient versus parental or isogenic neurons or slices; graded memantine versus perampanel versus d-APV; controls: wild type, heterozygote, vehicle, washout, an NMDAR-selective and an AMPAR-selective evoked-current check to define which receptor is raised (NMDA:AMPA ratio under voltage control, not the mEPSC decay); endpoints: burst frequency, duration, amplitude, phase-amplitude coupling, then a maturation endpoint; discriminating result: a partial block that abolishes bursting in knockout and spares wild-type activity versus one that does not.
p4_card.value_added: Separates two things the record had fused: the node (NMDAR-dependent network) and the sign of an intervention on it, and adds the one untested receptor with a direct measurement behind it.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.
